distinct_scientific_next_test.recommendation: Consider a distinct prospectively frozen ownership and error-complementarity study; this closed candidate does not advance.
distinct_scientific_next_test.scientific_question: Does sharing the native slow body constrain useful member error complementarity, independently of per-member competence and source correction?
evidence_basis: All twelve candidate members pass the frozen same-role native-single floor, but roles 1 and 2 have lower member mean F1 than both independent committees.
Role 3 has a higher candidate member mean F1 than both independent committees yet lower pooled F1, motivating direct error-overlap measurement.
Candidate pooled predictions are unchanged from own-only in every role despite selected nonzero accepted corrections.
Label3 false-positive excess is concentrated in roles 1 and 2 and appears in every shared arm.
minimum_design: A separately qualified four-cell design crossing native body ownership (shared versus four genuinely independent bodies) with own-only versus identical assigned source-J correction.

Identical six private factor sites, paired roles and prospective seeds, full inputs, source views, J/guards, dose rule, first opportunity/cadence, maximum horizon, own loss and selection policy; report realized selected/final opportunities and costs rather than assume matching.

Measure per-member competence, pool versus member mean, direct pairwise disagreement/error overlap, common-wrong and any-correct events, positive/negative repair/harm and full label confusion including label3 false positives on independently frozen unused outcomes.
Use all declared cells, both ownership controls and relevant strong comparators; freeze practical margins and claim-family/error-control rules before outcomes.
falsification: If competent independent bodies with identical J do not improve error complementarity and deployed quality relative to shared bodies, the ownership hypothesis is unsupported.
If pooled gain is explained by stronger members without reduced common errors, do not attribute it to diversity.
If assigned J adds no useful deployed gain to own-only under either ownership regime, retire this source-correction direction.
not_a_rescue: No lambda, correction-dose, horizon, threshold, label subset, role subset or candidate selection is proposed for this closed study.
The present record cannot prove that correlated errors caused the deficit; direct event overlap is a required measurement, not an assumed finding.
